segments.text: Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me; and, behold, he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and, lo, it was the latter growth after the king’s mowings.
And it came to pass, that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land, then I said,

segments.speaker: Amos
segments.text: O Lord GOD, forgive, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.

footnotes.text: + by…: or, who of (or, for,) Jacob shall stand?

segments.text: The LORD repented for this:

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: It shall not be, saith the LORD.
¶ Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me: and, behold, the Lord GOD called to contend by fire, and it devoured the great deep, and did eat up a part.
Then said I,

segments.speaker: Amos
segments.text: O Lord GOD, cease, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.

footnotes.text: + by…: or, who of (or, for,) Jacob shall stand?

segments.text: The LORD repented for this:

segments.speaker: The Lord GOD
segments.text: This also shall not be,
saith the Lord GOD.
¶ Thus he shewed me: and, behold, the Lord stood upon a wall made by a plumbline, with a plumbline in his hand.
And the LORD said unto me,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Amos, what seest thou?
And I said,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: A plumbline.
Then said the Lord,

segments.speaker: The Lord
segments.text: Behold,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: I will set a plumbline in the midst of my people Israel: I will not again pass by them any more:

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolate, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.
¶ Then Amaziah the priest of Beth-el sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying,

segments.speaker: The Lord
segments.text: Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel: the land is not able to bear all his words.

segments.speaker: The Lord
segments.text: For thus Amos saith, Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land.
Also Amaziah said unto Amos,

segments.speaker: Amaziah
segments.text: O thou seer, go, flee thee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there:

segments.speaker: Amaziah
segments.text: But prophesy not again any more at Beth-el: for it is the king’s chapel, and it is the king’s court.

footnotes.text: + king’s court: Heb. house of the kingdom

segments.text: ¶ Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah,

segments.speaker: Amos
segments.text: I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet’s son; but I was an herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit:

segments.speaker: Amos
segments.text: And the LORD took me as I followed the flock, and the LORD said unto me, Go, prophesy unto my people Israel.

segments.speaker: Amos
segments.text: ¶ Now therefore hear thou the word of the LORD: Thou sayest, Prophesy not against Israel, and drop not thy word against the house of Isaac.

segments.speaker: Amos
segments.text: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Thy wife shall be an harlot in the city, and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword, and thy land shall be divided by line; and thou shalt die in a polluted land: and Israel shall surely go into captivity forth of his land.
